name: Thinking orbs
summary: Animated thinking-orb loading states for AI interfaces: nine hand-tuned states on a 2D canvas, npm package thinking-orbs.
description: A small React library of thought-orb loading indicators for AI interfaces, with nine hand-tuned animated states on a 2D canvas. Install the thinking-orbs package from npm; this page has moved to a live playground at libraries.dev/orbs, where the orbs can be tuned in a Studio. Free libraries are MIT licensed; a Pro plan adds deep Studio customization.
contains: nine hand-tuned animated states on a 2D canvas
react-native port (thinking-orbs-native) is not on npm yet
moved to libraries.dev/orbs — one of seven libraries (beam, orb, avatars, gooey, metal, image, voice)
free libraries are MIT; Pro plan $9/mo adds the Studio and Pro presets
